text.title: Growth Experiment Design Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the one-page experiment spec: a hypothesis with one change, one segment, one primary metric and a numeric minimum effect; at least three guardrails covering revenue-or-conversion, retention and performance-or-error, each with a stop threshold; an ICE score with integer 1-10 parts and cited confidence; a sample-size block at alpha 0.05 and power 0.8 with a whole-week duration between one and eight weeks; flag-platform assignment hashed on a user id with a concurrent control; instrumentation with exposure logged when the variant is seen and a playback before ramp; a fixed stop date and an SRM check gate; and the write-up every experiment gets. Validator at scripts/validate-growth-experiment-design.py enforces it, including the sample-size arithmetic and the status gates.

required.field: kebab-case id, prefix `exp-`; the same id is attached to every exposure and metric event (r-instrumentation-playback-before-ramp)

`change`, `segment`, `primary_metric`, `minimum_effect_pct` (above 0) and `mechanism`; reads as "If we [change] for [segment], then [primary_metric] will change by at least [minimum_effect_pct] percent because [mechanism]" (r-hypothesis-falsifiable-with-effect-size)

at least three, each `name`, `category` (revenue_or_conversion, retention, performance_or_error) and `stop_threshold`; all three categories present; a breach vetoes a ship (r-one-primary-metric-plus-guardrails)

`impact`, `confidence`, `ease` as integers 1-10, `criteria_ref` to the team's written scoring criteria, `confidence_evidence` (null only when confidence is 3 or lower), `backlog_rank` (r-ice-scored-before-build)

`baseline_rate`, `minimum_detectable_effect_pct` equal to the hypothesis effect, `alpha` 0.05, `power` 0.8, `required_per_variant`, `eligible_daily_traffic`, `duration_weeks` 1-8 derived from the smallest allocation (r-sample-size-computed-before-launch)

`platform` (launchdarkly, statsig, unleash, growthbook, optimizely, internal), `design` randomised_controlled, `hash_key` user_id or account_id, `control_variant`, `allocation[]` of at least two variants summing to 100 (r-control-group-randomised-by-flag)

`exposure_event`, `exposure_logged_at` variant_seen, `analytics_destination`, `metric_events[]`, and `playback` with `cohort` (staging or one_percent), `status`, `performed_on`, `events_verified[]` covering the exposure event and every metric event (r-instrumentation-playback-before-ramp)
`launch_date`, `stop_date` at least `duration_weeks` whole weeks after launch, `sequential_method` null unless declared up front (r-fixed-stop-date-no-peeking-srm-check)
`status` pending, passed or failed, `chi_square_p` (required once read), `invalidates_below` 0.001; results are read only after it is recorded (r-fixed-stop-date-no-peeking-srm-check)
designed, playback_passed, running, stopped or written_up; running requires a passed playback, stopped requires a recorded SRM check, written_up requires a write-up

null until written; then `date` within seven days of `stop_date`, `log_entry`, `decision` (ship, iterate, kill), `primary_effect` with `observed_pct`, `ci_low_pct`, `ci_high_pct`, `guardrail_results[]`, `srm_p`, `belief_changed` (r-write-up-every-experiment)

forbidden.pattern: `hypothesis.primary_metric` that is a theme ("engagement", "activation") rather than a measured rate, or `minimum_effect_pct` absent or 0 — primary-metric-chosen-after-results
fewer than three guardrails, a category missing, or a guardrail without `stop_threshold` — primary-metric-chosen-after-results

`sample_size.required_per_variant` below what baseline, MDE, alpha 0.05 and power 0.8 imply, or `duration_weeks` outside 1-8, or a duration not derived from `eligible_daily_traffic` and the smallest allocation — underpowered-for-the-effect
`assignment.design` other than randomised_controlled, `hash_key` session or device based, or no control variant in `allocation[]` — pre-post-called-an-experiment
`instrumentation.exposure_logged_at` set to assignment, or `status` running with `playback.status` pending, or a metric event missing from `events_verified[]` — exposure-logged-at-assignment
`schedule.stop_date` earlier than `launch_date` plus `duration_weeks` weeks, or `status` stopped with `srm_check.status` pending — peeking-early-stop, sample-ratio-mismatch-ignored
`srm_check.chi_square_p` below `invalidates_below` with `status` passed, or a `write_up.decision` of ship on a failed SRM check or a breached guardrail — sample-ratio-mismatch-ignored
`counts_toward_velocity` true with `write_up` null, or a write-up dated more than seven days after `stop_date` — r-write-up-every-experiment

list.item: The hypothesis names one change, one segment, one measured primary metric and a minimum effect above zero, and the write-up reports that metric and no other as the headline.
Three guardrail categories are covered, each with a stop threshold that a reviewer can evaluate from the dashboard.

`sample_size.duration_weeks` is what `required_per_variant`, `eligible_daily_traffic` and the smallest allocation imply, rounded up to whole weeks, and `stop_date` is that many weeks after `launch_date`.
`playback.events_verified` lists the exposure event and every metric event before `status` moves to running.
`srm_check` is recorded before `status` moves to stopped; `write_up` exists before `counts_toward_velocity` is true.

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the cross-field rules (sample-size arithmetic, allocation sum, stop-date span, status gates, write-up deadline and veto).
